parentFieldName.description: Name of the field that refers to parents on vertexType

childFieldName.description: Name of the field that refers to children on vertexType

hierarchyDenormType.description: Hierarchy Denorm Type on which denormalize hierarchy is called

relationship.description: Specifies relationship between the edges. Null for strict hierarchies

batchWeight.description: Max number node (with lineage) in memory per schedule batch

batchSize.description: Max number nodes allowed in a particular schedule batch

workingSet.description: Ids of vertices that are in the working set for incremental denorm

isIncremental.description: To specify whether it is incremental denorm or not

edgesRemoved.description: If there were any edges removed in this batch

startFieldName.description: Field on the Edge's Type that represents the start date of the edge

endFieldName.description: Field on the Edge's Type that represents the end date of the edge

prefix.description: prefix to be used for the nodes that are created

depth.description: total depth of the tree. Root is at depth 1

branchingFactor.description: no of children that each node has

fromRoleType.description: fromRole Type - for non strict hierarchy (eg. Department)

toRoleType.description: toRole Type - for non strict hierarchy (eg. Department)
